description:
Search the logos of the products in Screenrove's library, as references for designing a
logo or app icon. Each logo is the product's own mark as its site serves it (SVG icon,
apple-touch-icon or large favicon; never redrawn), linked to its collection, with observed
traits: mark type (symbol, lettermark, wordmark, combination), colours sampled from the file
with colour families, shape (square tile, rounded tile, circle, freeform), whether its letters
are lowercase, the brand font and accent from the product's measured design guide, and its
category.

Use this for logo references: "lettermarks on a rounded tile", "green symbols", "how do
developer tools' icons look". Logos are trademarks of their owners: study them, don't copy them.

category.description: Comma-separated categories (OR), e.g. "Developer tools", or "ai" for both AI categories.

colour.description:
Comma-separated colour families (OR) - red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink,
brown, black, white, grey, or mono for single-colour glyphs that carry no colour.

includeMissing.description: Also list the library products that have no logo in the directory yet.

lowercase.description: Only letter-based marks whose letters are lowercase (true) or capitals (false).

markType.description: Comma-separated mark types (OR) - symbol, lettermark, wordmark, combination.

product.description: Comma-separated product ids or names, e.g. linear,stripe.

q.description: Keywords matched against product name, id, category and brand font.

shape.description: Comma-separated shapes (OR) - square tile, rounded tile, circle, freeform.

name: search_logos

font.description: Brand font from the product's design guide.

primary.description: The first colour that isn't black

source.description: Where the file was fetched from.

title: Search the logo directory
